basics.name: Mike Miller
basics.label: Senior Product Manager | Platform Products | Enterprise SaaS | Product Builder
basics.summary: Product leader with 10+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, internal business systems, and consumer software products. Currently leading platform product initiatives for ADP's next-generation global HCM platform serving 200,000+ monthly active users, 250+ enterprise clients, and 500+ developers across 10 countries. Experienced in product strategy, roadmap ownership, platform products, developer experience, design systems, analytics, growth optimization, and cross-functional leadership.

work.name: ADP
work.summary: Product owner for core platform capabilities supporting ADP's next-generation global HCM platform.
highlights: Own product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution for core platform capabilities powering ADP's next-generation global HCM platform.
Lead platform investments supporting 200,000+ monthly active users, 250+ enterprise clients, and 500+ developers across 10 countries.
Direct product vision and delivery for the UI engine, design system, developer tooling ecosystem, globalization services, and 10+ shared backend platform services.
Reduced application UI load times by 90% through platform modernization initiatives, improving performance and user experience at enterprise scale.
Led development of fully automated UI translation and localization capabilities, enabling more efficient global product deployment.

Launched an enterprise Org Chart Export platform enabling automated PowerPoint and PDF generation for organizations with 50,000+ employees, including end-user customization and developer/client governance controls.
Coordinate roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, capacity management, and cross-team dependencies across 2+ engineering teams of 5-10 engineers each.

work.name: ADP

highlights: Scaled platform adoption from roughly 10,000 users and single-digit enterprise clients to six-figure monthly active usage across 250+ clients.
Partnered with engineering, UX, architecture, and client stakeholders to balance customer needs, platform scalability, technical debt reduction, and long-term product strategy.
Established prioritization inputs from client feedback, platform analytics, performance metrics, developer needs, and engineering capacity.

work.name: ADP
highlights: Led developer experience initiatives, platform adoption programs, technical education, and product feedback loops for enterprise developers.
Served as a strategic bridge between engineering teams, product organizations, and platform consumers, influencing platform direction through customer and developer insight.

work.name: New York Code + Design Academy
work.position: Director of Marketing & Product / Brand Strategy / Student Experience / Community
work.summary: Led growth, student experience, and internal product initiatives, including SectionsCRM.
highlights: Led development of SectionsCRM, a custom admissions and student lifecycle platform used by 5,000+ users across admissions, marketing, operations, instructors, and prospective students.
Increased lead-to-application conversion from 33% to 50% and lead-to-enrollment conversion from 1.5% to 2.2% within three months of launch.
Increased daily contact rates from 15% to 20% by redesigning admissions workflows and lead management processes.
Fully automated student onboarding across 5+ institutional services, replacing manual provisioning workflows.
Doubled landing page conversion rates and increased acquisition performance by 200% through experimentation, user behavior analysis, and funnel optimization.
Improved student retention to 90%+ through engagement and lifecycle management programs.
